info.title: Payfunnels Universal API
info.description: Collect payments, create payment links, and manage subscriptions

put.description: Updates a subscription by cancelling it in Payfunnels.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

cancelDate.description: Unix timestamp used when cancellation option is custom_date.

id.description: ID of the subscription to cancel.

post.description: Creates a custom plan payment link in Payfunnels.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

description.description: Detailed description of the payment link.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the payment link, for example USD or GBP.

amount.description: Amount charged immediately when the custom plan payment link is used.

paymentSchedule.description: Payment schedule object containing chargePhases and finalChargePhase.

isTaxable.description: Whether the default tax rate should be applied.

forwardProcessingFees.description: Whether processing fees should be added to the payment link.

displayBillingAddress.description: Prompt the customer for a billing address.

enableTermOfService.description: Require the customer to accept terms of service.

additionalFields[].description: Additional checkout fields as an array of objects.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

description.description: Detailed description of the payment link.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the payment link, for example USD or GBP.

interval.description: Payment interval. Supported values are day, week, month, and year.

numberOfPayments.description: Number of payments to collect before the subscription cancels.

trialDays.description: Optional trial period in days. Must be greater than 2 days.
